description: This file implements contact management functionalities for an Android application, including searching for contacts, adding new contacts, and handling permissions. It defines data models, data source interface, a system contacts data source implementation, and a handler class that processes JSON requests and produces JSON responses.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact's information including identifier, display name, name components, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to search contacts with an optional query string and a limit on number of results.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to add a new contact with optional name and organization details, along with phone numbers and emails.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking permissions, searching, and adding contacts.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing ContactsDataSource to interact with Android's Contacts content provider, handling permission checks, contact search, and contact insertion.

classes.name: ContactsHandler
classes.description: Main class handling contact search and addition requests, parsing JSON parameters, managing permissions, and generating JSON responses.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch
methods.description: Processes a search request for contacts based on provided JSON parameters, returning a JSON result with contacts or an error.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd
methods.description: Processes a request to add a new contact based on provided JSON parameters, returning success or error JSON.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a ContactsSearchRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a ContactsAddRequest object.

methods.name: stringArray
methods.description: Converts a JsonArray into a List of non-empty trimmed strings.

methods.name: contactJson
methods.description: Converts a ContactRecord into a JSON object for response.
